observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/batch.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
RESULTS=/tmp/batch_results.txt
: > $RESULTS
for s in demos-einwendungsmanagement decision-log-store-service graph-api norm-matching rechtsquellenvorbereitung subsumtion-service risikohinweis-service ki-guv-explainability ki-guv-feedback ki-guv-ai-testing; do
  echo "=== building $s ==="
  timeout 580 /tmp/build_generic.sh "$s" "$s" > /tmp/b_$s.log 2>&1
  rc=$?
  if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "$s OK" >> $RESULTS; else echo "$s FAIL rc=$rc" >> $RESULTS; fi
done
cat $RESULTS
SH
chmod +x /tmp/batch.sh
nohup /tmp/batch.sh > /tmp/batch_out.log 2>&1 & echo "started $!"
